source: https://dewaterbus.be/en/pages/schedule (live DOM scrape via Chrome browser automation)
notes: Re-scraped 2026-08-26 (superseding the 2026-08-24 capture) specifically to detect and exclude struck-through cells: the live table marks a cancelled/non-running departure by wrapping its cell text in <s></s> instead of a plain <div>; a per-cell check for that <s> tag was used to exclude those times, in addition to the existing literal '-' filter.
Trips left with zero valid stop times after strikethrough filtering (i.e. every cell in that trip's column was struck through) were dropped entirely from the 'trips' array.

'north_to_south' stop order: Lillo, Liefkenshoek, Kallosluis, Zwijndrecht, Sint Anna, Steenplein, Kruibeke, Hemiksem. 'south_to_north' stop order is the reverse (Hemiksem...Lillo); note the stop label is 'Kallo' not 'Kallosluis' in this direction's table but it's the same physical stop.

Confirms the user-reported issue: north_to_south/weekday trip T29 (ship D4) has its Sint Anna cell struck-through live (kept Steenplein/Kruibeke/Hemiksem, which are not struck) -- so De Waterbus no longer offers 19:20 as a Sint Anna departure; the next one is trip T30 (ship D5) at 19:50, which is not struck.

day_type 'weekend_holiday' split into 'saturday' and 'sunday_holiday' blocks per the site's own tabs -- they were identical in the 2026-08-24 capture but are captured independently again here in case they've diverged.
All times are Europe/Brussels local (as displayed on the site).
